{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999

# Replace sentinel values with NaN
df_clean = df.copy()
df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(sentinel_value, pd.NA)

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (after cleaning)
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_biomarker_severe_clean)"}
